# Every window is generated from its own body and its own script. The html
# platform caches what does not vary by window (the analysis, the __n* id map,
# the esbuild bundle) across the whole compilation, so a page taking another
# page's cached work is exactly the failure this guards against: each page must
# carry its own text and its own updater, and none of the others'.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out site.sngl
exists out/index.html
exists out/beta.html
exists out/gamma.html
exists out/delta.html

# The first window generated fills the caches the rest read.
grep 'alpha body' out/index.html
grep 'alpha shows' out/index.html
! grep 'beta body' out/index.html
! grep 'beta shows' out/index.html
! grep 'gamma body' out/index.html
! grep 'gamma shows' out/index.html

grep 'beta body' out/beta.html
grep 'beta shows' out/beta.html
! grep 'alpha body' out/beta.html
! grep 'alpha shows' out/beta.html
! grep 'gamma body' out/beta.html
! grep 'gamma shows' out/beta.html

grep 'gamma body' out/gamma.html
grep 'gamma shows' out/gamma.html
! grep 'alpha body' out/gamma.html
! grep 'alpha shows' out/gamma.html
! grep 'beta body' out/gamma.html
! grep 'beta shows' out/gamma.html

# delta declares no state and no handler, so its page is the one that shows
# what a window inherited that is not its own: the analysis a window mutates
# during codegen (which helper functions its script needs, which CSS its
# components registered) is per-window, and only the package-derived half is
# shared. A leak here would give delta another window's runtime.
grep 'delta body' out/delta.html
! grep 'alpha body' out/delta.html
! grep 'beta body' out/delta.html
! grep 'gamma body' out/delta.html
! grep 'function String' out/delta.html
! grep 'addEventListener' out/delta.html

# Which window is generated first decides which one fills the caches, and must
# decide nothing else. Declaring the same three in the opposite order puts
# gamma first; every page must still carry its own content and none other's.
# (The pages are not byte-identical across the two orders: the __nN ids lower
# assigns follow source order. What must not change is whose text lands where.)
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=rev reversed.sngl

grep 'alpha body' rev/index.html
grep 'alpha shows' rev/index.html
! grep 'beta body' rev/index.html
! grep 'gamma body' rev/index.html

grep 'beta body' rev/beta.html
grep 'beta shows' rev/beta.html
! grep 'alpha body' rev/beta.html
! grep 'gamma body' rev/beta.html

grep 'gamma body' rev/gamma.html
grep 'gamma shows' rev/gamma.html
! grep 'alpha body' rev/gamma.html
! grep 'beta body' rev/gamma.html

grep 'delta body' rev/delta.html
! grep 'function String' rev/delta.html
! grep 'addEventListener' rev/delta.html

-- site.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var alphaCount = 0
    var betaCount = 0
    var gammaCount = 0

    window #alpha(title="Alpha", href="/") {
        text(value="alpha body")
        button(text="press alpha", @click { alphaCount += 1 })
        text(value="alpha shows {alphaCount}")
    }
    window #beta(title="Beta", href="/beta.html") {
        text(value="beta body")
        button(text="press beta", @click { betaCount += 1 })
        text(value="beta shows {betaCount}")
    }
    window #gamma(title="Gamma", href="/gamma.html") {
        text(value="gamma body")
        button(text="press gamma", @click { gammaCount += 1 })
        text(value="gamma shows {gammaCount}")
    }
    window #delta(title="Delta", href="/delta.html") {
        text(value="delta body")
    }
}
-- reversed.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var alphaCount = 0
    var betaCount = 0
    var gammaCount = 0

    window #gamma(title="Gamma", href="/gamma.html") {
        text(value="gamma body")
        button(text="press gamma", @click { gammaCount += 1 })
        text(value="gamma shows {gammaCount}")
    }
    window #beta(title="Beta", href="/beta.html") {
        text(value="beta body")
        button(text="press beta", @click { betaCount += 1 })
        text(value="beta shows {betaCount}")
    }
    window #alpha(title="Alpha", href="/") {
        text(value="alpha body")
        button(text="press alpha", @click { alphaCount += 1 })
        text(value="alpha shows {alphaCount}")
    }
    window #delta(title="Delta", href="/delta.html") {
        text(value="delta body")
    }
}
